views.displayName: Chromosome 1: CNVs, lifespan QTLs and selective sweeps

tracks.name: Selective sweeps, Early regime
tracks.description: Candidate selective-sweep regions consistently detected in the Early (short-lived) experimental evolution regime: Pool-HMM calls present in at least 6 of 8 pooled samples (4 lines x 2 sexes). Autosomes only.

tracks.name: Selective sweeps, Late regime
tracks.description: Candidate selective-sweep regions consistently detected in the Late (long-lived) experimental evolution regime: Pool-HMM calls present in at least 6 of 8 pooled samples (4 lines x 2 sexes). Autosomes only.

tracks.name: Coverage, Early regime median
tracks.description: Median read depth across the four Early lines (female and male pools summed per line), corrected for GC content and mappability, in 100 bp bins.

tracks.name: Coverage, Late regime median
tracks.description: Median read depth across the four Late lines (female and male pools summed per line), corrected for GC content and mappability, in 100 bp bins.

tracks.name: Coverage log2 ratio, Late vs Early
tracks.description: log2 ratio of median corrected read depth, Late vs Early, in 100 bp bins. Positive values indicate higher coverage in Late lines.

tracks.name: Coverage log2 ratio, Late vs Early, denoised
tracks.description: log2 ratio of median corrected read depth, Late vs Early, in 100 bp bins, denoised with a stationary wavelet transform. Input to the CNV segmentation.

tracks.name: CNV segmentation, Late vs Early
tracks.description: Circular binary segmentation of the denoised Late vs Early log2 coverage ratio; the value is the segment mean. All segments, before significance filtering.

tracks.name: CNV calls, Early regime
tracks.description: Copy-number variants (deletions and gains) differentiated between regimes, called for the Early regime (fold change >= 1.5, permutation P <= 0.05). Columns: call type and population-level copy number minus 2.

tracks.name: CNV calls, Late regime
tracks.description: Copy-number variants (deletions and gains) differentiated between regimes, called for the Late regime (fold change >= 1.5, permutation P <= 0.05). Columns: call type and population-level copy number minus 2.

tracks.name: CNV calls, Early regime (signal)
tracks.description: The Early CNV calls as a signal track. Value is population-level copy number minus 2 (negative = deletion, positive = gain).

tracks.name: CNV calls, Late regime (signal)
tracks.description: The Late CNV calls as a signal track. Value is population-level copy number minus 2 (negative = deletion, positive = gain).

tracks.name: Lifespan QTL LOD, interval mapping (markers)
tracks.description: LOD scores for lifespan from interval mapping (sex as additive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Original values at marker positions.

tracks.name: Lifespan QTL LOD, interval mapping (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD scores for lifespan from interval mapping (sex as additive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL LOD, interval mapping (markers)
tracks.description: LOD scores for body weight from interval mapping (sex as additive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Original values at marker positions.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL LOD, interval mapping (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD scores for body weight from interval mapping (sex as additive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Lifespan QTL LOD, MQM (markers)
tracks.description: LOD profiles of the six lifespan QTLs from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Original values at marker positions.

tracks.name: Lifespan QTL LOD, MQM (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profiles of the six lifespan QTLs from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL chr2 22.9 cM LOD, MQM (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profile of the body weight QTL on chromosome 2 at 22.9 cM from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL chr4 25.3 cM LOD, MQM (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profile of the body weight QTL on chromosome 4 at 25.3 cM from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL chr4 28.3 cM LOD, MQM (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profile of the body weight QTL on chromosome 4 at 28.3 cM from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL chr6 12.6 cM LOD, MQM (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profile of the body weight QTL on chromosome 6 at 12.6 cM from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL chr9 90.5 cM LOD, MQM (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profile of the body weight QTL on chromosome 9 at 90.5 cM from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate) in an Early x Late F2 intercross (1,334 F2 individuals). Linearly interpolated onto 100 kb bins for display.

tracks.name: Recombination rate, 100 kb
tracks.description: Local recombination rate (cM/Mb) estimated from crossovers in the Early x Late F2 intercross, per 100 kb, unsmoothed.

tracks.name: Recombination rate, 2 Mb smoothed
tracks.description: Local recombination rate (cM/Mb) estimated from crossovers in the Early x Late F2 intercross, 2 Mb moving average.

tracks.name: F0 founder coverage, Early line 2 mean
tracks.description: Mean read depth of the four F0 founders from Early line 2 (E2) of the QTL intercross, each normalized by its median depth, in 100 bp bins.

tracks.name: F0 founder coverage, Late line 5 mean
tracks.description: Mean read depth of the four F0 founders from Late line 5 (L5) of the QTL intercross, each normalized by its median depth, in 100 bp bins.

tracks.name: F0 founder coverage log2 ratio, L5 vs E2
tracks.description: log2 ratio of mean F0 founder read depth, Late line 5 vs Early line 2, in 100 bp bins, capped at -5 to 5. Positive values indicate higher coverage in L5 founders.

tracks.name: Genes, gene-level with ortholog annotation
tracks.description: Gene-level version of the GCA_963669975.1 gene annotation (one feature per gene, pseudogenes removed) with functional annotation from eggNOG-mapper v2.1.12.

tracks.name: Drosophila melanogaster orthologs
tracks.description: Drosophila melanogaster orthologs of A. obtectus protein-coding genes inferred with InParanoid-DIAMOND v5.1, placed at the position of the A. obtectus gene.

tracks.name: Differentially expressed genes, female abdomen
tracks.description: Genes differentially expressed between Early and Late lines in female abdomen (FDR < 0.05, absolute log2 fold change > 1; Immonen et al. 2023), placed on this assembly by aligning transcripts with GMAP. Score is the log2 fold change; positive = higher expression in Early lines.

displays.mouseover: jexl:"Gene ID: " + get(feature,'geneid') + ", Log2 Fold Change: " + get(feature, 'score')

tracks.name: Differentially expressed genes, female head and thorax
tracks.description: Genes differentially expressed between Early and Late lines in female head and thorax (FDR < 0.05, absolute log2 fold change > 1; Immonen et al. 2023), placed on this assembly by aligning transcripts with GMAP. Score is the log2 fold change; positive = higher expression in Early lines.

displays.mouseover: jexl:"Gene ID: " + get(feature,'geneid') + ", Log2 Fold Change: " + get(feature, 'score')

tracks.name: Differentially expressed genes, male abdomen
tracks.description: Genes differentially expressed between Early and Late lines in male abdomen (FDR < 0.05, absolute log2 fold change > 1; Immonen et al. 2023), placed on this assembly by aligning transcripts with GMAP. Score is the log2 fold change; positive = higher expression in Early lines.

displays.mouseover: jexl:"Gene ID: " + get(feature,'geneid') + ", Log2 Fold Change: " + get(feature, 'score')

tracks.name: Differentially expressed genes, male head and thorax
tracks.description: Genes differentially expressed between Early and Late lines in male head and thorax (FDR < 0.05, absolute log2 fold change > 1; Immonen et al. 2023), placed on this assembly by aligning transcripts with GMAP. Score is the log2 fold change; positive = higher expression in Early lines.

tracks.name: Excluded regions, high coverage
tracks.description: Regions with abnormally high read depth (above the 99th percentile) in the pooled samples of both regimes; masked in the analyses.

tracks.name: Excluded regions, low coverage
tracks.description: Regions with abnormally low read depth (below the 7th percentile) in the pooled samples of both regimes; masked in the analyses.

tracks.name: Excluded regions, low mapping quality
tracks.description: Regions where fewer than 40% of reads have mapping quality >= 10 in the pooled samples of both regimes; masked in the analyses.

tracks.name: Excluded regions, assembly gaps and small contigs
tracks.description: Regions within 150 bp of an assembly gap, and contigs shorter than 20 kb; masked in the analyses.

tracks.name: GC content
tracks.description: GC content per 100 bp bin, as a fraction (0-1).

tracks.name: Mappability
tracks.description: Mappability per 100 bp bin, as depth of simulated paired-end reads mapped back to the assembly (0-300; divide by 300 for a 0-1 scale).

tracks.name: Coverage, Early and Late regime medians (overlay)
tracks.description: The Early and Late median corrected read depths (100 bp bins) in one plot. Early in orange, Late in purple. See the two single tracks for details.

tracks.name: CNV calls, Early and Late regimes (overlay)
tracks.description: The Early and Late CNV call signals as two density rows. The value is the population-level copy number minus 2 (negative = deletion, positive = gain).

tracks.name: F0 founder coverage, E2 and L5 means (overlay)
tracks.description: Mean read depth of the four F0 founders from Early line 2 (E2, orange) and from Late line 5 (L5, purple) of the QTL intercross, in one plot.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL LOD, MQM, all five QTLs (100 kb interpolated)
tracks.description: LOD profiles of the five body-weight QTLs from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate), one row per QTL, interpolated onto 100 kb bins.

tracks.name: Body weight QTL LOD, MQM, all five QTLs (markers)
tracks.description: LOD profiles of the five body-weight QTLs from multiple QTL mapping (MQM; sex as interactive covariate), one row per QTL, at marker resolution.
